user.title: ES Heat Pump – Credentials
user.description: Enter your myheatpump.com portal credentials. The integration logs in automatically and fetches all sensor data. For EU portal accounts, pick https://eu.myheatpump.com from the dropdown.

data.power_entity: Electrical-power sensor (optional, used for COP calculation)
data.mode_source_entity: Operating-mode source entity (no longer needed since v2.4.0 — the unit reports its mode in par1)
data.dhw_margin_k: Flow-temperature margin above the heating setpoint that marks DHW mode (K). Flow above setpoint + margin ⇒ domestic hot water.
data.flow_entity: Live volumetric-flow sensor (optional — overrides the constants, recommended if the circulation pump modulates)
data.model: Heat-pump model — selecting it fills in the datasheet nominal flow rate
data.enable_writes: Allow writing to the unit (off by default — required for settings entities, the restore service and parameter_setzen)
data.settings_interval: Configuration poll interval (seconds) — settings change rarely, 900 is plenty
data.backup_interval_h: Automatic backup interval (hours) — a change is always backed up immediately, this is the idle heartbeat
data.backup_keep: Number of backups to keep (0 = unlimited). Backups taken before a write or a restore are never deleted.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed — wrong username or password.
error.cannot_connect: Connection to portal failed. Check the URL (EU users: https://eu.myheatpump.com) and your network.
error.unknown: Unknown error — please check the Home Assistant logs.

origami_theme_missing.title: Origami theme not installed
origami_theme_missing.description:
The ES Heatpump dashboard is set to the "Origami" design, but the theme "{theme}" is not installed. Until it is, Home Assistant shows the default theme.

To install: Marketplace/HACS → download the repository "hazymorning/origami" (category theme), then run the action "frontend.reload_themes" under Developer tools → Actions. The Montserrat font is optional, see the Origami README. This notice then disappears by itself.
